test_title: PYST 1: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 24 Jul, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Fill in the blank with most appropriate option:
She was ___ embarrassed to speak in front of the class.
solution:
The correct answer is '**too**'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
__
 
• The word "**too**" is used to indicate excessiveness. In this sentence, it conveys that she was excessively embarrassed to speak in front of the class.
 
• Other options such as "**fairly**", "**quite**", and "**somewhat**" do not fit the context of extreme embarrassment.
 
• **Option 2** is grammatically correct and matches the intended meaning of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.
 
**Complete Sentence:** *"She was **too**__ embarrassed to speak in front of the class."*
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "fairly"** indicates moderation, which does not align with the context of excessive embarrassment.
 
• **Option 3: "quite"** suggests a high degree but not necessarily excessiveness, making it less appropriate here.
 
• **Option 4: "somewhat"** implies a mild level of embarrassment, which contradicts the intended meaning of the sentence.
